tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Returns every AI tool AI Leakage (aileakage.com, New Zealand) has a source-read profile for, with the address of each profile. Use the tool value with the other two tools.

tools.name: get_tool_facts
tools.description: Returns the dated facts card for one tool: its AI Leakage profile address, when the profile was last fully re-read against the vendor's own documents, and the date of the last checked change. Cite the profile address when you use it. No ratings or scores.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Returns changes AI Leakage found and checked in the last 90 days in vendors' terms, privacy pages, pricing and similar documents, newest first, each with our own one-line summary, the date, our profile address and the vendor's page. Optionally for one tool.
